name: Vegetable Korma
summary: Mixed vegetables in a mild coconut and peanut sauce, served over rice. Peanut butter stands in for the cashews.

ingredients.name: smooth peanut butter (or 50 g raw cashews; see notes)

instructions: Cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 6–8 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Whisk in the coconut milk, peanut butter, sugar, and 125 mL water until smooth. Bring to a simmer.
Add the frozen vegetables and simmer 8–10 minutes until hot and the sauce coats them. Season with salt and serve over rice.

glutenFree.notes: Coconut milk, peanut butter, vegetables, rice, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Check the garam masala label for added flour.

budgetNotes: Cashews are the traditional thickener. To use them instead of peanut butter, soak 50 g (about 1/3 cup) raw or unsalted cashews in boiling water for 15 minutes, drain, and blend with the coconut milk until smooth. Add it in step 4 in place of the peanut butter.
Cashews cost about $21/kg, so 50 g is about $1.09 and the recipe total goes from $9.03 to about $9.91. The smallest bag (about $6 for 275 g) still keeps a first-time shop under $15, at about $14.82.
Peanut allergy: use the cashew version, or leave both out and simmer a few minutes longer to thicken. Cashews are a tree nut.
Add a drained can of chickpeas ($1.50) for protein. That puts the total at about $10.50.
